blocks.content:
• CVC is a statutory body, NOT constitutional.
• Given statutory status in 2003.
• Supervises CBI in corruption cases.
• Maximum two vigilance commissioners.
• Not an investigative agency.
CVC is a statutory body, NOT constitutional.

items: Exams often incorrectly label CVC as a Constitutional body; remember it received Statutory status in 2003.
Do not confuse CVC with an investigative agency; it only holds supervisory powers over CBI in corruption cases.
Pay attention to composition limits: a maximum of two Vigilance Commissioners are allowed.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: CVC is a statutory body, NOT a constitutional body.
Statutory status was granted to the CVC in the year 2003.
CVC supervises the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) in corruption cases.
There can be a maximum of two Vigilance Commissioners.
CVC is a supervisory authority and NOT an investigative agency.
